choices.why: Its distressed cognac leather and slim black metal legs give the aged-leather industrial look the user asked for, and it can float generously in this large open loft.
A solid plank-wood top on black metal sled legs is exactly the requested coffee table, sized well in front of the sofa.
Its warm wood tray shelves on slender black metal poles are the most authentic black-metal-and-wood bookcase, and its 140 cm width fits the right wall beside the door.
A black swing-arm reading lamp in dark metal with brass details is the industrial floor lamp the user wants, avoiding bright white.
At 335 cm it is large enough to anchor the sofa and table, and its rust and terracotta motifs echo the cognac leather and wood.
A pair of earthy jacquard cushions in rust, ochre and charcoal softens the leather and ties the sofa to the rug.
This matte dark pot is the dark planter requested and suits the black metal accents.

answer.why: Distressed cognac leather, solid wood and dark black metal repeat across every piece, matching the loft's exposed wood beams and wood floor. The rust-toned rug and cushions add warmth without any bright white.
